title: Listening Drill — Tea tasting event — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Tea tasting event — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on tea tasting event last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with bitter flavour. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: wrong label.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of steeping time so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow water cup instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the event host before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Wednesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
